name: Faldir's Cove
summary: Blackwater Raiders now shelter at Faldir's Cove after disaster struck their fleet on the Arathi coast. The harbor also recalls the early settlers who sailed south from here to found Stormwind.

sections.title: A Gateway South and a Pirate Haven
sections.body: South of Stromgarde Keep, Faldir's Cove lies behind the bluffs, reached through a hidden tunnel beneath the ground. The harbor bears the name of Faldir, an ancient Arathor explorer whose expedition sailed across the Great Sea to establish Stormwind. Now Blackwater Raiders from Booty Bay shelter in its waters. Captains Steelgut and O'Breen led them north in search of ancient elven treasures, but their expedition became trapped in the bay.

sections.title: The Wreck of the Blackwater Fleet
sections.body: The Blackwater expedition met disaster on the Arathi coast. Unnatural tides, stirred by territorial naga on the offshore Drowned Reef, shattered two of their three ships. Only the Harbinger reached Faldir's Cove intact. With naga prowling the waters and their navigation charts lost beneath the waves, the surviving pirates and gnomish researchers are stranded. They rely on travelers to fight the aquatic horrors and recover salvage from the seabed.

faq.answer: Faldir was an ancient pioneer from the human empire of Arathor. He and his followers sailed south from this coast across the sea to establish the settlements that became Stormwind.

faq.q: How do you reach Faldir's Cove?
aliases: how to get to faldir's cove
faq.answer: Reach Faldir's Cove through a hidden tunnel just southeast of Stromgarde Keep's outer southern walls. The passage runs beneath the ground and opens onto the secluded shore.

faq.q: Why are the Blackwater Raiders here?
faq.answer: Captain Steelgut and Captain O'Breen led the Blackwater Raiders north from Booty Bay to seek sunken elven treasures. Gnomish inventors came with them, carrying devices designed to detect gems in the offshore reefs.
Hostile naga on the Drowned Reef stirred unnatural tides that destroyed two of the expedition's three vessels. The flagship Harbinger reached the cove, but the crew's charts sank beneath the waves.

angles.text: As a human, you stand on the coast where your ancestors left Arathor and sailed south toward the settlements that became Stormwind.
As a gnome, you can find Doctor Draxlegauge and Professor Phizzlethorpe at the camp, using engineering devices to study and extract elven gems from the calcified coastal reefs.
